[SWS_StbM_00497] ⌈The function StbM_EthSetPdelayInitiatorData shall be
pre compile time configurable ON/OFF. If the EthTSyn module is configured with Time
Validation Support enabled (refer to parameter EthTSynTimeValidationSupport
in EthTSyn module), StbM_EthSetPdelayInitiatorData shall be ON, otherwise
OFF.⌋(RS_TS_00034)
[SWS_StbM_00498] ⌈If the switch StbMDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE, StbM_EthSetPdelayInitiatorData shall report to DET the development error STBM_
E_PARAM, if called with a parameter timeBaseId, which does not refer to a Synchronized Time Base⌋(SRS_BSW_00386, SRS_BSW_00323)
[SWS_StbM_00499] ⌈If the switch StbMDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE, StbM_EthSetPdelayInitiatorData shall report to DET the development error STBM_
